text:
Daria Nguyen: Notifying ops 9: we started seeing spikes of 502/504 errors from the control-plane API during a canary rollout at ~15:02 UTC. Symptoms: model uploads failing, webhook callbacks timing out. Opening thread.

Marcus Li: Seen it. Error traces show DB connection pool exhaustion on control-plane write replicas. Canary rollout increased concurrent metadata writes.

ops-bot: deploy: rollback-canary model-mgmt v2026.06.11 initiated by @Marcus Li at 15:09 UTC 9 stages passed.

Alex Romero: Immediate mitigations: 1) paused the canary rollout 2) increased DB pool max_conns from 120 -> 240 for write-replicas 3) added short-term request queueing for model-upload path to smooth bursts.

Daria Nguyen: Impact: approximately 0.7% of hosted API requests encountered 502/504 during 15:0215:12 UTC; ~12 customers reported failed uploads. No inference corruption.

Marcus Li: Root cause (prelim): the canary turned on a metadata fanout that writes per-shard replication markers. Under higher concurrency it opened many short-lived DB sessions that piled into the pool. Connection reuse/gc behavior exacerbated it.

Alex Romero: Quick SRE commands for follow-up:

```bash
# check DB pool utilization across replicas
pg_stat_activity --host write-replica-1 --csv | grep state | wc -l
# show current max connections
psql -h write-replica-1 -c "SHOW max_connections;"
# temporarily limit concurrent uploads at the API layer
rdwctl rate limit set --path /v1/models/upload --concurrency 40
```

ops-bot: incident-severity: SEV3 (customer-impacting transient errors).

CS-bot: Draft customer bulletin posted to #support-digest and queued for review: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/2923456789 9 contains impact window + workaround.

Daria Nguyen: Metrics update: after rollback + pool bump p95/error-rate recovered by ~15:18 UTC. We're keeping upload queueing in place for 30 minutes to avoid re-burst.

Marcus Li: Follow-ups: 1) Alex to open a PR to implement connection pooling improvements in the metadata writer with pooled clients and backpressure, 2) Daria to produce timeline + RCA, 3) CS to finalize and send customer note. Target: RCA + customer update by EOD.

Alex Romero: I'll also add a canary gating check to fail canary if DB connections > 80% for 2m. Opening PR now and tagging oncall.

Daria Nguyen: Quick note: adding DB pool utilization alert to MTL so we catch this earlier.

Marcus Li: Thanks team. No data loss, rollback successful. Keeping thread pinned until RCA posted. :pin:

CS-bot: Affected customers notified; account teams standing by for follow-ups.
